text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I are on our way<n>back from a
day out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe the day is over<n>already. Time
truly does fly when<n>you're having fun...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful time, but that has<n>been enough
enjoyment for one day.<n>I ought to get ready to for
tomorrow's<n>cla—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, something in the<n>supermarket
window catches Symboli<n>Rudolf's attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm... Stuffed peppers do sound<n>awfully good...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind waiting here a<n>moment? I'm just
going to buy<n>ingredients for tomorrow's lunch.
choice_data_list: I can give you a hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, if you're certain, I could<n>hardly refuse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the help. I can turn<n>these into quite
the nutritious lunch<n>tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Do you always make your own lunch?
Do you always make your own lunch?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Usually, yes. As a Tracen Academy<n>student, it's my
duty to monitor the<n>food I consume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The food served in the cafeteria is<n>designed to
meet our nutritional<n>needs, of course...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But seeing as the student council<n>office doubles as
a place to seek<n>advice, I would prefer not to vacate
it<n>during the lunch period.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To that end, I try to bring a packed<n>lunch to eat there
whenever I can.
choice_data_list: I wanna see what you cook!
That must be a lot of work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah! What an odd thing to fixate on. I<n>cannot
imagine it would be especially<n>interesting to look
at...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would also be a little embarrassed to<n>simply waft
my lunch under your<n>nose. What do you say I make
you<n>one too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You help me every day. I would only<n>be returning
the favor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, cooking for one makes it<n>remarkably
difficult to avoid wasting<n>food.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I often find myself obliged to donate<n>excess
portions to Brian and Air<n>Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, they've told me<n>this directly, so
I'll warn you in<n>advance...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My lunches are known for looking<n>quite plain.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, I get the chance to<n>try Symboli
Rudolf's cooking for<n>myself. It won't win any
awards for<n>presentation, but it tastes extremely
nutritious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It can be onerous at times, but the<n>benefits are
worth the effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For one thing, having a task before<n>me first thing in
the morning helps me<n>to wake up full of purpose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Against the temptations of slumber, I<n>levy the shield
of diligence and the<n>sword of appetite.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Oops.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... You're as perceptive as<n>ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As you correctly deduced, I'm not a<n>naturally early
riser.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I take measures to ensure that it<n>doesn't affect my
responsibilities, but<n>there's no changing my
constitution.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, this is strictly confidential<n>information.
Nobody below<n>vice-presidential level must know.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's smile turns just a<n>little
mischievous.
